decisions.reason: Despite limited website visibility, the multi-model product line represents substantial sunk costs, and management continues to justify the earlier launch.
Its dedicated website page signals public commitment, and any weak results are still seen as temporary.
The product has its own page and aligns with the announced Industry 4.0 direction, so the firm remains committed.
As the flagship product line shown on the home page, it is highly visible and central to the firm's announced direction, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The public new-product launch page and building on the established offer create commitment, and early results can be attributed to the ramp-up phase.
The trade-fair award is a public success that reinforces commitment, and the specialized system is kept to exploit the positive signal.
